name: Typographical Emphasis Profiling
description: Analyzes the frequency and structural placement of text emphasis (bolding, italics, ALL CAPS). AI models rely heavily on formulaic emphasis patterns, such as universally bolding the first phrase of every bullet point.
mechanism: Human writers use typographical emphasis (bold, italics, capitalization) organically and irregularly to convey genuine emotion, clarify complex distinctions, or simulate vocal inflection. In contrast, Large Language Models treat emphasis—particularly markdown bolding (**)—as a structural crutch rather than an emotional tool. When generating explanatory text, AI models exhibit a pathological adherence to standard formatting templates. A classic AI signature is the 'Bold-Start Bullet Point': generating a list where exactly the first 2-5 words of every single item are bolded, followed by a colon and a plain-text explanation. AI also rarely uses italics for subtle intonation or ALL CAPS for raw excitement, as these violate its neutral alignment. This method parses the text to extract all instances of typographical formatting and analyzes their variance, density, and structural predictability. A text where emphasis is distributed with mechanical, metronomic regularity (e.g., exactly one bolded phrase per paragraph) strongly indicates the rigid formatting templates inherent to machine generation.
useCase: Detecting AI generation in blogs, marketing copy, and informative articles where the formatting feels 'too perfect' and highly predictable, lacking the organic irregularity of human styling.
strengths:
• Highly effective at catching unedited 'raw' output from models like ChatGPT and Claude, which default to heavy markdown usage for readability.
• Identifies high-level formatting heuristics that are completely missed by standard vocabulary-based AI detectors.
• Simple to explain to users, as the 'bold bullet point' phenomenon is widely recognized as an AI cliché.
limitations:
• Easily defeated if the text is pasted as 'plain text', stripping out all markdown formatting before analysis.
• Will trigger false positives on human-written texts that strictly follow corporate style guides or highly structured instructional formats (e.g., technical documentation).
• Ineffective on text formats that do not support rich typography (like standard SMS messages).
parameters:
Analysis: Markdown Parsing & Emphasis Span Distribution
Metric: Structural Regularity of Formatting Tokens (Variance of Placement)
Output: 0-100 Formatting Rigidity (Metronomic Emphasis) Score
accuracy: Moderate to High — 75-85% on formatted text. It acts as a powerful structural heuristic, identifying the visual 'fingerprint' of an LLM's default output template.

references.title: Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Bhat, M. et al. (2020). How Formats Shape Text. NAACL.
